ctx.x: We just [SINGS]... I forget the name of it. [SINGS 8 BARS] And they had some different changes in tempos, you know, one of those things. And West couldn't get it, so I had to end up playing it on the drums. "Well," I said, "I told you this would happen."

Then we finally decided to break out of there. By this time, Joe had quit and went back to New York. Yeah. Freddie Bowman(?) was in now. Scoops is gone now; Scoops had gone with Earl, I think -- Earl or Fletcher.
